---
title: "Save Path Resolver"
format: html
---

## Overview

`SavePathResolver` provides Qt-free helpers for choosing provenance-aware default save targets for a `DataManager` key. It checks `LineageRegistry` for matching `FileOrigin` metadata and falls back to `DataManager::getOutputPath()` plus the UI-provided name.

This keeps provenance-aware save defaults out of the inspector widgets and leaves overwrite policy in `SaveData` (single-file) or the format options (multi-file).

## API

### Single-file saves

```cpp
commands::SavePathResolution resolveDefaultSavePath(
    DataManager const& data_manager,
    std::string const& data_key,
    std::string const& requested_format,
    std::string const& fallback_filename);
```

`SavePathResolution` returns the full path, parent directory, filename, and a `m_using_file_origin` flag. Callers use that flag to enable backup-on-overwrite only when saving back to the loaded source file.

### Multi-file saves

```cpp
commands::MultiFileSavePathResolution resolveDefaultMultiFileSaveDir(
    DataManager const& data_manager,
    std::string const& data_key,
    std::string const& requested_format,
    std::string const& fallback_parent_dir);
```

`MultiFileSavePathResolution` returns the parent directory for per-frame output files and a `m_using_file_origin` flag. Callers should set `overwrite_existing = true` in the saver config when `m_using_file_origin` is true, because multi-file savers skip existing files by default.

## Behavior

### `resolveDefaultSavePath`

- If the key has `FileOrigin` metadata and its format matches the requested saver format, the resolver returns the original load path (treated as a single file).
- If no matching origin exists, the resolver returns `DataManager::getOutputPath() / fallback_filename`.

### `resolveDefaultMultiFileSaveDir`

- If the key has `FileOrigin` metadata, the format matches, and the origin describes a multi-file load (`multi_file: true` in `m_source_config_json`, or `m_path` is an existing directory), the resolver returns `m_path` as the parent directory.
- If no matching multi-file origin exists, the resolver joins `fallback_parent_dir` with `DataManager::getOutputPath()` when the fallback is relative (or `"."`), otherwise uses the absolute fallback path as-is.

Neither resolver modifies `DataManager`, lineage metadata, or the filesystem.

## Call Sites

Data inspector save handlers use these helpers before constructing `SaveDataParams`. `LineInspector` uses `resolveDefaultMultiFileSaveDir` for CSV multi-file line export. `SaveData` remains responsible for the actual write and optional `.bak` backup for single-file targets.
